title: Entropy, cross-entropy and KL divergence
summary: Compute entropy, cross-entropy and KL divergence of discrete distributions in any log base, with the right answers for zero probabilities.

mutants.ignores_base: Always uses the natural log and ignores the base argument.
mutants.nan_on_zero: Computes 0 times log 0 directly, which gives NaN for a zero probability.
mutants.kl_reversed: Computes the KL divergence from q to p and not from p to q.
mutants.kl_clips_inf: Clips q away from zero, so the KL divergence stays finite when q is 0 where p is not.
mutants.cross_entropy_swapped: Weights log p by q, which is the cross-entropy of q relative to p.
